failureExits: Every nonterminal phase may append a failure event; the next mutation is forbidden until exact same-plan reconciliation with fresh owned proof. Unknown effect or quiescence forbids later effects; age never resolves it.
samePlanResume: Same plan/migration/scope/target/request/idempotency key only; no second migration, no replaced marker, no new generation as stale-owner recovery
terminalReentry: Read and validate existing seal and event/inventory chain. Normal3 is a NEW lease over current mutable floor and channel; never replays migration startup.
cohortRules: Both old restart policies read back no before first stop
Member PC2 must reach BOOTSTRAP_VERIFIED_RESTART_NO before PC4 stop
Any first-member failure blocks PC4 cutover
Both members verified before inventory publication
Per-member phases and cohort phase cannot be inferred from container running
